Details.description:
The full practice-area selector payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"How can we help?","subtitle":"Tap an area to see how we can help - then start your conversation","areas":[{"id":"injury","name":"Personal Injury","blurb":"Accidents, negligence & claims","icon":"injury","description":"We pursue full compensation for accident and negligence victims - medical bills, lost wages, and pain and suffering. No fee unless we win.","services":["Car & truck accidents","Slip & fall","Medical malpractice","Wrongful death"],"stat":"$50M+ recovered","href":"/practice-areas/personal-injury"},{"id":"family","name":"Family Law","blurb":"Divorce, custody & support","icon":"family","description":"Compassionate guidance through divorce, custody, and support - protecting your family and your future at every step.","services":["Divorce","Child custody","Child & spousal support","Prenuptial agreements"],"stat":"1,200+ families helped","href":"/practice-areas/family-law"},{"id":"estate","name":"Estate Planning","blurb":"Wills, trusts & probate","icon":"estate","description":"Plan ahead with wills, trusts, and powers of attorney so your wishes are honored and your loved ones are protected.","services":["Wills","Living trusts","Probate","Power of attorney"],"stat":"Flat-fee packages","href":"/practice-areas/estate-planning"},{"id":"business","name":"Business & Corporate","blurb":"Formation, contracts & disputes","icon":"business","description":"From formation to contracts to disputes, we help businesses operate and grow with confidence.","services":["Entity formation","Contracts","Partnership disputes","M&A"],"stat":"500+ businesses advised","href":"/practice-areas/business-law"},{"id":"immigration","name":"Immigration","blurb":"Visas, green cards & citizenship","icon":"immigration","description":"Guiding individuals, families, and employers through visas, green cards, and citizenship.","services":["Family visas","Work visas","Green cards","Naturalization"],"stat":"98% approval rate","href":"/practice-areas/immigration"},{"id":"criminal","name":"Criminal Defense","blurb":"Charges, DUI & expungement","icon":"criminal","description":"Aggressive, confidential defense against charges - protecting your rights, your record, and your freedom.","services":["DUI / DWI","Drug charges","Assault","Expungement"],"stat":"Available 24/7","href":"/practice-areas/criminal-defense"},{"id":"employment","name":"Employment","blurb":"Disputes, contracts & rights","icon":"employment","description":"Standing up for employees and advising employers on workplace rights and compliance.","services":["Wrongful termination","Discrimination","Wage & hour","Severance review"],"stat":"Free consultation","href":"/practice-areas/employment-law"},{"id":"realestate","name":"Real Estate","blurb":"Purchases, leases & closings","icon":"realestate","description":"Smooth closings and sound advice for buyers, sellers, landlords, and investors.","services":["Purchases & sales","Leases","Title review","Zoning & disputes"],"stat":"2,000+ closings","href":"/practice-areas/real-estate"}],"linkText":"Learn more","submitText":"Get help with {name}","submitValue":"I need help with"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading above the list. Defaults to 'How can we help?'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short supporting line under the title.
- 'areas' (array, required): the practice areas the firm handles. Each item MUST have 'id' (string, a stable key sent back on selection) and 'name' (string). Each MAY have: 'blurb' (string, a short one-liner under the name), 'icon' (string, one of injury|family|estate|business|immigration|criminal|employment|realestate|other — picks the row icon; unknown values fall back to a scales-of-justice icon), 'description' (string, shown when the row is expanded), 'services' (array of strings — common matter types, shown as chips), 'stat' (string, a trust signal, e.g. '$50M+ recovered'), and 'href' (string, the firm's page — rendered as a display-only 'Learn more' affordance, NOT a working link).
- 'linkText' (string, optional): label for the display-only link. Defaults to 'Learn more'.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): the per-area Get-help button label; use '{name}' to interpolate the area name. Defaults to 'Get help with {name}'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): the message sent back to the agent when a Get-help button is tapped. If it contains '{name}' it is interpolated; otherwise the area name is appended (e.g. 'I need help with' becomes 'I need help with Personal Injury').

Include only real practice areas the firm actually handles; leave 'areas' empty only to preview the built-in sample. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
